details.description: The accepted 20260729-preset-workflow-agents release is the current production baseline; target preflight must revalidate the live seven-Agent snapshot before any write.

checks: Detached exact source revision 6fc1737e3aae9cb9fa3745ec3113e45e411d87e4 in an independent local clone.
Contact migration fixture passed: seven legacy records updated, a second run left all seven unchanged, and rollback restored the exact original documents.
Preset Agent contact removal tests passed eight groups.
Original preset Workflow Agent operation tests passed seven groups against the updated compiled catalog.
Release governance validation passed all 32 tests and both governance Skills validated.
git diff --check passed and the detached validation tree remained clean.
Packaged artifact SHA-256 independently rechecked as ee11a0a87af4637a2cffe7160ec49e76cb06f398dc676b03ce3bc76cdeb2e3b3.

change_summary.expected_result: The seven managed preset Workflow Agents no longer expose a top-level support_contact, so Agent details do not show 联系: LibreChat Workflow Agent. Names, descriptions, tools, models, category, promotion, ACLs, conversation starters, personal Agents, Skills, files, conversations, and services remain unchanged.
functions: Stop the deterministic preset catalog compiler from injecting the legacy support_contact field.
Run a versioned target operation against exactly seven stable managed Agent IDs.
Validate the persisted drift digest and prove the contact is the only intended catalog difference.
Unset support_contact, advance the persisted template digest, and append a contact-free version snapshot.
Verify ACLs, categories, owner records, access roles, protected containers, and public boundaries are unchanged.
Create a targeted backup and automatically restore the exact seven Agent documents if apply or verification fails.
limitations: This release changes the current records for the seven system-managed preset Agents only.
LibreChat generic support contact schema and user-created Agent contact editing remain available.
No billable model request is required; browser acceptance checks the rendered Agent detail and API state.
No service is restarted or rebuilt during the data-only operation.
change_summary.reason: The seven preset Workflow Agents currently contain a placeholder LibreChat Workflow Agent contact with no usable email. It adds noise to the Agent detail and is not a real support channel.
change_summary.risk: A broad or incorrect Mongo update could alter user Agents, ACLs, categories, or version history. The operation uses stable IDs, managedBy and digest guards, a read-only snapshot, agents-only write scope, exact targeted backup/rollback, and post-write equality checks for all non-Agent target data.

details.command: Run deployment/production-operations/2026-07-29-preset-agent-contact-removal/scripts/rollback.sh with the timestamp-matched backup directory and a local result path.
details.restore_scope: Replace only the seven stable managed Agent documents with the exact preflight EJSON. Do not touch ACLs, categories, users, Skills, files, conversations, or services.
details.restore_source: The runtime preflight data_snapshot copied into the timestamped production backup before the first Mongo write.

validation_plan.expected: The compiled catalog omits support_contact, the migration is proven by an in-memory update/idempotence/rollback fixture, both Agent operation contracts pass, governance tests pass, and the tree has no whitespace errors.
The exact seven-Agent snapshot, legacy contact scope, owner and access roles, runtime capabilities, protected service identities, resources, and public checks pass with write_operations empty.

Only the seven managed Agent documents are updated; support_contact is absent after the write, non-Agent target snapshot sections are unchanged, no service restarts, and a timestamped backup is recorded.

validation_plan.command: Authenticated vip998 browser/API acceptance on desktop and mobile
validation_plan.expected: The seven preset Agents remain visible and their details no longer show 联系: LibreChat Workflow Agent; personal Agent, Skill, file, and conversation entry points remain available.
